message.old_content.kit: Old content unlocked! Received 16 rubies, a quiver, 16 gears and 64 arrows. Use the quiver to store arrows; sneak-use to retrieve them. Gears are decorative. Full inventory? Check the ground!
tooltip.old_content.quiver.store: Use: store ordinary arrows from your inventory
tooltip.old_content.quiver.withdraw: Sneak + use: retrieve all stored arrows
tooltip.old_content.quiver.bow: Retrieve arrows before firing a bow.
